articles.title_en: ‘They killed us’: Russian independent newspaper Novaya Gazeta announces its closure after decades of repression
articles.lead_en: Novaya Gazeta, the best-known independent news outlet still operating inside Russia, has announced that it is closing. The day before, it became known that the editorial staff was being evicted from its office in Potapovsky Lane in central Moscow, where journalists had worked for 29 years.
